issues.detail: The Greek text includes the specific description 'διαμαρτυραμενοι' (having borne witness/testified), which is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.

The Greek 'πολλας τε κωμας' refers to 'many villages' (or settlements) of the Samaritans. The Vietnamese 'nhiều làng của người Sa-mari' is a correct rendering of the location, but the Greek 'τε' suggests a sequential or additive structure ('and') that is slightly flattened in the Vietnamese flow.
